LESSON: VERSE

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.8: Verse

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Verse
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can verse performance be made interesting and memorable?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

3. perform a verse before an audience
